name: Shinonome Karin
source:
Hobbies: Sewing and handicrafts (sucks at it, though)
Likes: Apple pie
Dislikes: Technology

A girl who lives in delusions because she doesn't care about the real world at all. Due to this she tends to not notice the things that happen around her, nor when she accidentally does something lewd with her body. She feels sympathy towards [url=/c54699]Seita[/url]. She also tends to read his surname as "Hiriaru (Non-real)", which amuses Karin to no end.
